_comment: Minimal single-network repro: mlp_control ONLY, non-periodic (single pass), through the XPU-RT scheduler + xpurt_demo combined-binary runtime on spike. Built to isolate whether the ~13-16x actual-vs-predicted instruction-count gap seen on dronet/yolov8_nano in the 3-network schedule (networks_mlp_dronet_yolo_spike.json) is inherent to the xpurt dispatch mechanism itself (fence+semaphore overhead per dispatch, worker-thread indirection) or specific to multi-network interleaving/contention. Compare this build's per-dispatch predicted vs actual (mtime-based, converted via the verified ~100:1 rdcycle:mtime ratio) against a plain standalone `examples/mlp_control/run.sh` run.
